modules.name: road_round_shift
modules.description: Nine-stage globally enabled exact signed rounding and int16 saturation primitive, no multiplier.

ports.name: i_advance
ports.description: Enclosing pipeline enables all stages only if its held output can advance

ports.name: i_input_valid
ports.description: Input transfers only with advance high

ports.name: i_product
ports.description: Exact signed upstream product excluding INT64_MIN

ports.name: i_shift
ports.description: Right shift zero through sixty-two; sixty-three faults

ports.name: i_tag
ports.description: Opaque payload identity held with product

ports.name: o_result_data
ports.description: Signed saturated int16; unspecified on fault

ports.name: o_fault
ports.description: Unsupported shift or minimum int64; never publish as normal result

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.values: Every pipeline register and valid bit clears to zero.

behavior: Nine enabled edges including input acceptance produce output; latency eight enabled rising-edge intervals.
II is one enabled clock; invalid input inserts a bubble.
i_advance low freezes valid, fault, tag and all datapath registers; caller must deassert it if output cannot be accepted.
Round exact absolute quotient/remainder with nearest even, restore sign and saturate to signed int16.
Unsupported input yields a tagged fault; result data must be ignored.
Reset cancels all tokens, including stalled output.
constraints: Verilog-2001 only, no multiplier or DSP claim.
Only one clock domain, common clock enable, no gated clocks.
This primitive is not an independently elastic ready/valid stage; enclosing pipeline owns readiness.
INT64_MIN is outside the upstream legal int32 times nonnegative int32 product range.
corner_cases: Shift zero has no fractional increment.
Negative half ties restore sign after even rounding.
Positive and negative saturation never wrap.
Stalls extend elapsed latency by exactly their duration.
verification_cases: Exact Fraction vectors cover all sixty-three legal shifts and positive/negative half ties.
Self-checking RTL tests include continuous tokens, bubbles, common-enable stalls, tags, fault and reset cancellation.

timing_diagrams.title: Enabled clocks and a common stall
timing_diagrams.description: Two adjacent tokens reach the output after eight enabled intervals; common stall holds them and all payloads.
